artifact: INSAaf AI — Pakistan document & drafting taxonomy (corpus-grounded) for final_v3 drafting/editing training rows

status_scale.FULL: required content/steps verified in indexed corpus or official pages (canonical for drafting rows)
status_scale.PARTIAL: only part of the drafting rules indexed; drafting rows must teach caveats, never invent omitted rules
status_scale.SUMMARY: digest-level summaries only (topic areas, not section text); drafting rows stay strictly at digest level
status_scale.GAP: governing law not indexed; document type listed so drafting rows are NOT generated for it

types.name: Sale deed (immovable property)
types.purpose: Registered transfer of title to immovable property
types.corpus: property.txt MUTATION_INTEQAL: mutation does NOT create title — legal title comes from the registered sale deed; mutation updates revenue records (Patwari application, Tehsildar notice, Fard-e-Malkiat). property dispute records list title-deed/fard needs.
types.flow: draft deed with parties/property/consideration -> execute + register sale deed -> buyer applies for mutation to Patwari -> Revenue Officer (Tehsildar/Naib Tehsildar) notice -> sanction -> Fard update
types.note: Registration Act 1908 and Stamp Act 1899 not indexed (stamp duty/registration-office rules = gap); drafting rows must mark fee/registration details as verify-in-office

types.name: Mutation (Inteqal) application
types.purpose: Update government land revenue records (Fard) after a property transaction
types.corpus: property.txt MUTATION_INTEQAL (steps verified above); contestation via revision before Collector/Board of Revenue or civil suit for declaration
types.flow: apply to local Patwari -> Tehsildar/Naib-Tehsildar notice -> no objection + verification -> sanction -> new owner recorded

types.name: Rent/lease agreement
types.corpus: tenancy.txt digests: rent control by province (Punjab Rented Premises Act 2009, Sindh Rented Premises Ordinance 1979, KP Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance 1959, ICT Rent Restriction Ordinance 2001); Rent Controller adjudicates; eviction grounds digested (default in rent, sublet without permission, nuisance, personal need)
types.flow: parties + premises + rent + term + permitted use -> agree eviction-law grounds awareness -> dispute route = Rent Controller
types.note: no prescribed-form text indexed; drafting rows must not assert mandatory clauses beyond the digested grounds

types.name: Eviction application (Rent Controller)
types.purpose: Landlord seeks eviction on statutory grounds
types.corpus: tenancy digests (grounds above) + rent tribunals in court_hierarchy (Rent Tribunals under provincial Rent Acts; appeals to District Judge/HC)
types.flow: notice to tenant -> application on statutory ground -> Rent Tribunal/Controller -> appeal

types.name: Nikah (marriage) registration record
types.corpus: family.txt covers nikah, dower (mahr) and Muslim marriage registration areas of the MFLO 1961 digest
types.flow: consent of parties -> two male (or one male + two female) witnesses -> dower stated -> nikah registrar record -> registration per MFLO rules as digested
types.note: rule-level detail of MFLO (registration time limits, forms) not fully indexed — drafting rows keep to digested facts

types.name: Talaq notice (s.7 MFLO route)
types.purpose: Effective divorce by husband with statutory notice
types.corpus: family.txt MFLO areas (talaq + arbitration-council route digested)
types.flow: notice in writing to Chairman Union Council + copy to wife -> 90-day period -> arbitration council attempt -> effective on expiry as digested
types.note: exact s.7 wording not verbatim in corpus; rows teach the digested route only

types.name: Khula suit / dissolution petition
types.corpus: family.txt: Dissolution of Muslim Marriages Act 1939 digests (grounds incl. cruelty/desertion/missing husband/failure to maintain) + Family Courts Act 1964 exclusive jurisdiction; court hierarchy family courts
types.flow: petition in Family Court -> conciliation attempt -> decree on proved ground (khula on restitution basis as digested) -> appeal to HC
types.note: post-1961 khula doctrine not exhaustively indexed; rows teach digest-level grounds

types.name: Maintenance petition
types.corpus: family.txt maintenance digests + Family Courts Act 1964 exclusive jurisdiction
types.flow: petition in Family Court -> quantum hearing on means of parties as digested -> enforcement route as digested

types.name: Child custody / guardianship petition
types.purpose: Care and custody of minor children
types.corpus: family.txt guardianship digests + Family Courts Act 1964 jurisdiction (court hierarchy: family courts custody)
types.flow: petition in Family Court -> welfare-of-the-minor standard as digested -> interim custody as digested
types.note: Guardians and Wards Act 1890 detail not fully indexed

types.name: Will (wasiyat)
types.corpus: succession.txt digests: Muslim wills — bequeathable one-third, bequest to heir requires consent of other heirs (as digested)
types.flow: declaration + witnesses -> limit 1/3 to non-heirs -> bequest to heir void unless heirs consent after death (digest level)
types.note: Succession Act 1925 probate/admin areas partially digested

types.name: Inheritance distribution statement
types.corpus: succession.txt + property.txt PROPERTY_INHERITANCE (son double daughter share; wife 1/8 with children, 1/4 without — as digested)
types.flow: identify heirs -> apply shares by class as digested -> partition suit route (Partition Act 1893) for joint property
types.note: comprehensive share tables (e.g., 12-class table) not indexed — rows must refuse exhaustive claims

types.name: FIR (first information report)
types.purpose: Set criminal process in motion for a cognizable offence
types.corpus: police.txt (s.154 CrPC registration duty; refusal remedies) + procedure/procedures.txt FIR records (free copy entitlement; investigation start) + workflows
types.flow: oral/written information at police station -> SHO registers cognizable offence FIR (free) -> complainant gets free copy -> investigation
types.note: rows: FIR must be registered for cognizable offences; refusal ladder = SHO -> SP/DSP -> JP 22A/22B -> magistrate s.200 -> HC Art 199 -> Citizen Portal 8171 -> IGP cell

types.name: Application to Justice of Peace (s.22A(6) CrPC)
types.purpose: Direction to register FIR after police refusal
types.corpus: court-procedure/procedures.txt FIR_REFUSAL_REMEDY_22A (5 steps incl. 7-day SP window, evidence attachments, JP direction)
types.flow: written complaint SP/SSP/DPO -> wait 7 days -> s.22A(6) application before DSJ (ex-officio JP) with affidavit + postal receipts + evidence -> JP calls police report -> direction to SHO

types.name: Private complaint (s.200 CrPC)
types.purpose: Direct complaint to Magistrate when FIR route fails
types.corpus: procedures.txt remedy 4 + crpc.txt s.200 areas (magistrate takes cognizance; complainant evidence; 265C supply rules)
types.flow: complaint in writing to Judicial Magistrate -> statement on oath as digested -> inquiry/summons -> trial

types.name: Bail application (pre-arrest s.498A / post-arrest s.497 CrPC)
types.corpus: court-procedure/procedures.txt PRE_ARREST_BAIL_PROCEDURE record (s.498A) + crpc digests (497 bail when not bailable; case law: bail is rule, jail exception — expanded_case_law)
types.flow: application before Sessions/HC as digested -> grounds (prima facie, flight risk, tampering) -> conditions as digested

types.name: Civil suit plaint
types.corpus: cpc.txt digests (plaint essentials areas, s.9 jurisdiction, pecuniary limits court hierarchy) + property dispute procedures (declaration s.42 SRA, possession s.8, injunction s.54-56 SRA; limitation Art 144 12-year recovery)
types.flow: cause of action + parties + valuation -> court of competent jurisdiction -> court fee (fee law not indexed) -> service -> written statement -> trial
types.note: CPC Orders 6/7 not systematically indexed; court-fee specifics = gap

types.name: Written statement / defence
types.corpus: cpc.txt digest level (defence filing areas; 265C is criminal-side supply rule — do not conflate)
types.flow: file within prescribed CPC period as digested -> deny/confess paragraphs -> set-off/counterclaim areas as digested

types.name: Constitutional writ petition (Art 199)
types.purpose: Challenge executive/administrative action or enforce rights
types.corpus: court_hierarchy HC jurisdiction Art 199 (habeas corpus, certiorari, prohibition, mandamus, quo warranto) + remedies digests + aid.txt letter-to-CJP alternative for FR enforcement (Art 184(3) SC)
types.flow: identify illegal action/absence of alternative remedy -> petition in provincial HC or IHC -> interim relief -> final order as digested
types.note: locus/alternative-remedy doctrine only at digest level

types.name: Complaint to Federal Ombudsman (WMS Form A)
types.corpus: civic_services.txt + citizen_official_procedures.txt (solemn affirmation 4 points; 72h receipt; annexures; first-approach-agency practice; child helpline 1056)
types.flow: Form A / online -> affirmation (if not Form A) -> annex CNIC + correspondence -> submit Secretariat/regional -> receipt immediate/72h -> inquiry

types.name: Voter registration forms (21/22/23)
types.corpus: civic_services.txt + citizen_official_procedures.txt + elections.txt (eligibility incl. s.27 Elections Act 2017 residence; expired CNIC deemed valid)
types.flow: Form 21 (enrol/transfer) / 22 (objection/deletion) / 23 (correction) + CNIC copy -> DEC/RO/ARO -> SMS 8300 check

types.name: NICOP application (overseas Pakistani)
types.purpose: Identity/nationality proof for Pakistanis abroad (s.12 NADRA Ordinance 2000)
types.corpus: civic_services.txt (types, eligibility bullets, document categories, PakID + Registration Centre routes)
types.flow: PakID app (New NICOP -> details -> documents -> RC visit if needed -> track) or in person at Registration Centre

types.name: Passport application
types.corpus: civic_services.txt + citizen_official_procedures.txt (8 in-person steps; online path; ECL/BL stop; minors gazetted-officer attestation; SMS 9988/Rabta; one-window desks)
types.flow: counter -> photo+QR token -> biometrics -> data entry verify/sign -> ECL/BL check -> AD interview -> QR fee -> delivery to self/blood relative

types.name: FIA complaint (Public Services Portal)
types.corpus: civic_services.txt + citizen_official_procedures.txt
types.flow: portal -> register complaint (FIA jurisdiction) -> reference for status -> feedback on FIA offices/immigration counters

types.name: Legal-aid application (DLAC/DLEC)
types.purpose: Free legal representation for those who cannot afford it
types.corpus: aid.txt (DLAC via District Bar Association/District Court; state counsel capital cases s.340 CrPC + Art 10; priority categories) + workflows.txt DLEC route (LAJA for women/children criminal; DLEC via Deputy Commissioner or District Judge; Zakat certificate/income affidavit)
types.flow: prove indigency -> DLAC (bar association/court) for civil/criminal OR DLEC/LAJA per forum -> committee review -> lawyer from panel, fee by state

types.name: Power of attorney
types.corpus: none indexed
types.note: no drafting rows; registered-POA rules (Registration Act) not indexed

types.name: Workplace harassment complaint (Act 2010 committee)
types.purpose: Internal redress under Protection against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act 2010
types.corpus: women.txt (Committee + complaint areas digested)
types.flow: written complaint to Inquiry Committee -> inquiry as digested -> Ombudsperson/appeal route as digested
types.note: section-level detail of Act 2010 not fully indexed

types.name: Employment contract / appointment letter
types.corpus: labour.txt digests (contract/regularization areas; SCP 2026 official records add regularization/pension doctrine: KPK regularization acts deeming clauses, Punjab Civil Services Pension Rules qualifying service)
types.flow: offer -> terms (pay/leave/termination notice) -> regularization rules per service law as digested
types.note: provincial service rules not indexed beyond case records

types.name: Company incorporation documents
types.purpose: Register a company under Companies Act 2017
types.corpus: companies.txt topic digests (incorporation/memorandum/registration areas — topic numbering not act sections)
types.flow: name reservation -> MoA/AoA -> SECP registration as digested -> post-incorporation filings as digested
types.note: drafting rows only at digest level; exact forms = SECP (not indexed)

types.name: PECA cybercrime complaint
types.corpus: peca.txt digests (offences + FIA jurisdiction areas) + FIA portal records
types.flow: FIA complaint portal / cybercrime wing -> report offence (defamation s.20, harassment s.21 areas as digested) -> investigation

types.name: Consumer complaint (Consumer Court)
types.corpus: consumer.txt digests (provincial consumer acts; no/minimal court fee; summary trial) + SCP 2026 consumer-protection points (official record) + court hierarchy consumer courts
types.flow: complaint to Consumer Court -> summary procedure -> relief as digested -> appeal to HC
